units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 5:9">Kel. V, 9</cite> <he>תנור … ועשה לו ל׳</he> an oven which came in parts from the workshop and which (after being put up) was surrounded with a frame.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 5:9">Ib.</cite> <he>סלק את לִימּוּדָיו</he> ed. Dehr. (oth. ed. <cite ref="L00480"><he>לִמּ׳</he></cite>) if the frame was removed; <cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 4:12">Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. IV, 12</cite>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 7:9">Ib. VII, 9</cite> <he>עין של תנור … ל׳ וכ׳</he> a chimney-flue which is lined with boards.

<cite ref="Tosefta Pesachim 7:1">Tosef. Pes. VII, 1</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Moed Katan 2:2">M. Kat. II, 2</cite> <he>עושה לו ל׳ וכ׳</he> he makes a frame of shingles and covers the vat that the wine may not get sour; a. e.

<cite ref="Tosefta Challah 1:7">Tosef. Ḥall. I, 7</cite>; Y. ib. I, end, 58ᵃ <he>עשאה ל׳ פטורה</he> if he made the ‘dog’s dough’, into ‘shingles’, it is exempt (from Ḥallah); <cite ref="Berakhot 38a:11">Ber. 38ᵃ</cite> <he>כל׳</he> ed.; v. <cite ref="K00965"><he>כַּעַךְ</he></cite>.
